d:
I translated this doujin and cleaned it by hand, I also removed the white bar censors in a drawing software.
I took some light liberties to properly fit character voice.

The original doujin is up for free on the artists Pixiv: https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/3101579

Extra note: The released doujin is only chapter one, Dear Verosika and Dear Stolas seemed to have only been released in physical print.
